name: Triple Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 3 times its normal price, in tech points: Science level 2 11,000 -> 33,000, level 3 150,000 -> 450,000; Medicine level 2 8,000 -> 24,000, level 3 75,000 -> 225,000; Alchemy level 2 5,000 -> 15,000, level 3 55,000 -> 165,000; Restoration level 2 7,000 -> 21,000, level 3 85,000 -> 255,000; Leadership level 2 7,000 -> 21,000, level 3 125,000 -> 375,000; Nature level 1 4,500 -> 13,500, level 2 50,000 -> 150,000, level 3 150,000 -> 450,000; Magic level 1 4,500 -> 13,500, level 2 50,000 -> 150,000, level 3 150,000 -> 450,000. The Tech screen shows the tripled price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. The two factions, Nature and Magic, are technologies too: choosing one costs 3 times as much. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. **Needs no other patch.** Makes the game super hard.
behavior_changes: Every non-zero entry of the technology price table 0x4A818C, x 3. Its only reader is the getter 0x427020, called by the Tech screen's hover label, information box and purchase (0x464C84, 0x464E47, 0x465706): the shown price, the purchase's refusal threshold and the amount it takes are the same tripled number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
